meta.name: Newlyweds
meta.description: A mature romance about a free-spirited woman and a reserved professor who marry quickly after a brief, passionate courtship.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Over six weeks and two continents, total opposites Jeanie and James go from blind date to wedded bliss.

videos.title: My Place or Yours
videos.overview: Jeanie and James realize they have very different ideas about where they should live.

videos.title: We'll Never Have Paris
videos.overview: James and Jeanie can't get a moment alone during their at-home mini-moon.

videos.title: Back in Time
videos.overview: A therapy session with Claudia reveals some surprising secrets about Jeanie and James' whirlwind romance.

videos.title: Thanksgiving
videos.overview: James tries to bring Thanksgiving joy back to Jeanie with some very unexpected results.
